name: hvac-dashboard
description: Dev-only manifest — the app itself ships zero client-side dependencies. This exists solely so the jsdom-based suites (tests-js/kiosk.test.js and tests-js/dashboard-maintenance.test.js) can require jsdom; tests-js/dashboard-functions.test.js is intentionally dependency-free, extracting pure functions straight out of hvac-dashboard.html via sentinel comments rather than needing a DOM at all. kiosk.html's PIN lock screen and hvac-dashboard.html's Settings modal are inherently DOM-driven — form fields, click handlers, rendered table rows — so testing them for real needs an actual DOM implementation; see each test file's own header comment for details.
